ios.desc:
Quick, unscramble the word!

HOW TO PLAY
Drag the letter tiles to form the correct word. Use a hint or shake to shuffle if you get stumped!

FEATURES
– End-of-level stats show how well you played
– Unlock hidden achievements while playing the game
– Replay a level to beat your record
– Earn a special level rank if your record is in the top 25% of players worldwide
